title: Rust memory safety
content: Rust uses ownership, borrowing, and lifetimes to provide memory safety without requiring a garbage collector. Its compiler checks these rules before a program runs.

title: Python concurrency
content: Python supports concurrency with asyncio for cooperative I/O, threads for blocking I/O, and processes for CPU-bound parallel work. The Global Interpreter Lock affects execution of Python bytecode in many standard builds.

title: C++ performance
content: C++ can provide predictable, low-level control over memory and execution. Performance still depends on algorithm choice, data layout, compiler optimization, and careful measurement.

title: AI infrastructure
content: AI infrastructure combines compute, storage, networking, model serving, and observability. Reliable systems measure latency, throughput, resource use, and failure rates across the full inference path.

title: PostgreSQL vector search
content: PostgreSQL with pgvector stores embedding vectors alongside relational data. Cosine-distance indexes can accelerate nearest-neighbor queries, while PostgreSQL full-text search can contribute keyword matches.

title: Bread baking
content: Bread dough develops structure as flour hydrates and gluten forms. Fermentation produces gas and flavor, while oven heat expands the loaf and sets its crumb.
